strategy: Prism is reserved for Munkidori and never intentionally attached to an evolving Marnie line.
With one Darkness already attached, Prism is used when Mind Bend gives an immediate KO, a forced attack, an endgame backup, or a Crustle wall route.

With zero Energy, Prism may replace the first Darkness only when no Darkness is in hand and Adrena-Brain is immediately useful; against real Crustle it may be used earlier to preserve Basic Darkness for Punk Up.
Historical 10-Darkness replays are treated as the same deck lineage as the 9-Darkness + 1-Prism list.
status: accepted as requested deck variant; general performance was near-neutral and actual Crustle was non-inferior in the targeted batch
